summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 1 Job Browsing and Matching flow. All core features working correctly: Find Jobs page shows job cards with all required fields, Pass/Interested buttons work, applications appear in Matches page with correct status badges, and 'Waiting for a match' state shows for pending applications.

issues: Sidebar still shows 'References' and 'Connections' navigation items - may need removal per Phase 1 requirements if these features are not part of MVP

passed_tests: Find Jobs page (/seeker/swipe) loads and shows job cards
Job card displays: title, facility name, location, pay range, specialty, description
Two action buttons visible: Pass (X icon) and Interested (Heart icon) with labels
Clicking 'Interested' records the action and shows 'Interest sent!' toast
GET /api/seeker/applications endpoint returns the user's liked jobs with status
Matches page (/matches) for seekers shows 'Your Applications' list
Each application in list shows status badge (Pending/Matched/Offer)
Selecting a pending application shows 'Waiting for a match' state instead of chat
Matches page for employers works with legacy /matches endpoint
Dashboard Find Jobs button navigates to /seeker/swipe
No references or connections visible in Find Jobs page content
No references or connections visible in Matches page content (seeker view)
Backend: employers cannot access seeker swipe endpoint (403)
Backend: employers cannot access seeker applications (403)
action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider removing 'References' and 'Connections' from employer sidebar if not part of Phase 1 MVP

success_rate.backend: 100% - 11 passed, 2 skipped (no jobs available after swiping)

seed_data_creation: Used existing test accounts and jobs in database
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Job Browsing and Matching flow fully tested and working. SwipePage has Pass/Interested buttons (no Maybe). MatchesPage for seekers calls GET /api/seeker/applications which returns liked jobs with status (pending/matched/offer). For employers, it uses GET /api/matches. Test seeker has multiple applications in 'pending' status. The 'Waiting for a match' state correctly shows for pending applications. All backend endpoints properly secured with authentication and role-based access control.
